t: What he recited striking a rock in the trench
a: تَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ صِدْقًا وَعَدْلاً لاَ مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
p: Tammat kalimatu rabbika ṣidqan wa ʿadlā, lā mubaddila li-kalimātih, wa huwa-s-samīʿu-l-ʿalīm
m: The word of your Lord is complete in truth and justice. There is no changing His words. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
